clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Carla era nella 3ª colonna e nelle Stalle, ma non era accanto a un cactus.
clues.en: Carla was in the 3rd column and in the Stables, but was not beside a cactus.

clues.it: Tea era nella 3ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Fabio e nel Saloon.
clues.en: Tea was in the 3rd row, in a different room from Fabio and in the Saloon.

clues.it: Marta era nella 5ª colonna e accanto a un pianoforte.
clues.en: Marta was in the 5th column and beside a piano.

clues.it: Fabio era accanto a un pianoforte, ma non era accanto a una cassaforte.
clues.en: Fabio was beside a piano, but was not beside a safe.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 1ª colonna e accanto a un pianoforte o a una sella.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 1st column and beside a piano or a saddle.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 7ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Carla.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 7th column, in the 7th row and in the same room as Carla.

clues.it: Luca era nella 9ª colonna e accanto a un cactus, ma non era accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.
clues.en: Luca was in the 9th column and beside a cactus, but was not beside a saloon stool.

clues.it: Olga era nella 10ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e all'Emporio.
clues.en: Olga was in the 10th column, in the 9th row and in the General Store.

clues.it: Vito era nella 4ª colonna, nella 10ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Marta.
clues.en: Vito was in the 4th column, in the 10th row and in a different room from Marta.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a un carro ed esattamente una riga a nord di Rosa.
clues.en: Nino was beside a wagon and exactly one row north of Rosa.

clues.it: Rosa era in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Rosa was in a different room from Fabio.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Carla lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Carla's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Solo Tea può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 8ª è sua.
steps.en: Tea is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 5th.

steps.it: Solo Fabio può stare nella 5ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Fabio is the only one who can be in the 5th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Bruno's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 6th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 7th.

steps.en: Luca is the only one who can be in the 8th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 10th.

steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 4th.

steps.en: Nino's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 11th, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Anna può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 11ª è sua.
steps.en: Anna is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.

steps.en: Rosa's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 12th, column 12th.
